findings: The old _CHECKOUT_REL remains unchanged and is used only by stored_body_path/stored_derived_path.

The new _BUNDLE_DIRECTORY_REL is used only by bundle_directory and permits the specified Unicode/space/.git/long components while rejecting forbidden separators and controls; minLength=7 and maxLength=4096 are present.
Repository input/saved patterns and all three URL patterns use component-boundary exclusions; json_pointer maxLength=16416 and span.column_end maximum=262145 are present.

main refuses an existing or symlink output path, writes only fixed schema/profile paths below the fresh output directory, performs no source/network/subprocess reads, and never deletes or overwrites an existing path.
fixture_bundle validates every positive case before returning; unknown/missing-field traversal does not deduplicate branches and permits only the request-input root limits deletion.
_walk_typed preserves numeric string dictionary keys and integer list indices; strict-integer negatives cover bool, float, and IntSubclass.
Boundary tests cover repository input/saved and commit/blob/raw URLs, pointer 16416/16417, span column_end 262145/262146, and bundle directory lexical/Unicode/control/length cases.
Targeted config result/reason, declaration kind/span, git outcome/reason/walk plus schema-only unsafe, and saved-root/reference hash cases are single-field mutations from fixture-validated positives.
coverage_notes_non_blocking: The unknown-field marker is hard-coded as __unknown_field__; it is safe for the reviewed fixture but a per-node guaranteed-absent marker would be more defensive.

The saved-ID test identifies roots by ce1: syntax rather than filtering saved-document titles, and does not separately mutate reference-object id syntax; existing fixture assertions still require a root and reference hash case.
